description:
Atomic Inventory Reservation

Implement a thread-safe (atomic) inventory reservation system for a single product.

Requirements:

  • GET /api/v1/inventory/status: Return the current remaining stock in the format { "remaining": N }.
  • POST /api/v1/inventory/reserve: Reserve a specific quantity of items.
  • If stock is sufficient, decrement the inventory and return 200 OK.
  • If stock is insufficient, return 409 Conflict with { "message": "Insufficient stock" }.
  • Concurrency: Multiple simultaneous requests must be handled correctly without over-selling.
